name: Deceiving
overview: Scripture reveals that deceiving is fundamentally tied to the nature of the devil, who is described as the father of lies and the deceiver of the whole world (John 8:44; Revelation 12:9). Believers are warned to stand firm against his schemes by putting on the full armor of God (Ephesians 6:11). The Bible also highlights the internal danger of self-deception when one hears the Word but does not act on it (James 1:22), emphasizing the need for a pure heart and conscience to discern truth from falsehood (Titus 1:15). God’s hatred of deceit is underscored by His abhorrence of certain sins, including lying and deception (Proverbs 6:16).
